observations: A vintage-style treadle sewing machine on a wooden table with a metal frame.
The machine is black with gold decorative lettering and patterns.
The brand name 'SINGER' is visible in gold lettering on the side of the machine body in photo 0.
The machine has a handwheel on the right, a presser foot, and a needle assembly.
The wooden table has a drawer with a brass label that reads 'SINGER' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'.
The metal treadle mechanism is visible below the table.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some wear and minor scratches on the wood and metal parts.
There is a watermark 'LAWRENCE OKOSUN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the photo.
